newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares open higher but hesitant.
newsitem.headline: French shares open higher but hesitant.

text.p: French shares opened higher on Tuesday, boosted by Wall Street, but the early advanced paled in comparision with the Dow Jones jump of over two percent.
Political worries are keeping investors on their toes with opinion polls on Monday showing an advance for either the Left or the Right.

Due to the French voting system it is difficult to predict the number of seats on the basis on the voting intentions. The dollar, which had been suporting Paris for some time, was subdued in Europe on Tuesday.
The CAC-40 index was up 0.11 percent at 2675.73, May futures were up five at 2,667.
Eurotunnel, down 1.49 percent at 6.60 francs on Tuesday said it had received a mixed decision in its long-running conflict over cost overruns with builders TML.
Air Liquide, up 2.05 percent at 897 francs, said its first quarter sales were up 12.4 percent.
